subject: U-442 r2 integrated: suite green, Greptile clean on new head, guard RED held
body: Ran scoped gitleaks over 0056bf16..HEAD (15 commits, 0 leaks), got the full suite green at e4cbf222 (Ran 1726 tests in 315.625s / OK) plus validate.py (all 21 missions valid), wrote the egress receipt 5b4dfa3d before pushing, pushed with --force-with-lease, then reconciled Greptile on the new head and committed docs/reports/u-442/integrate-r2.json as maintainer with no trailers. Greptile RAN and was CLEAN — its check-run on e4cbf222 started 09:12:06Z (after the push) and reports '38 files reviewed, 0 comments added', so held_new is empty, and both round-1 P1 holds are RESOLVED by the new head: 4056474414 (artifact-pin bypass) and 4056474416 (cross-repo symbol grep) are fixed in 3fca0bb9, carry named regressions plus a killed mutant, and both threads show isResolved=true; note the push needed no force at all, since after fetching, origin/u-442 was still a strict ancestor and git reported a fast-forward 0056bf16..e4cbf222. One NEW blocker is held and unfixed per the HOLD contract: CI 'guard' is RED on this head because floor_guard flags the coverage pragma at runtime/scripts/verify.py:209 that P1-1's fail-closed OSError branch introduced — it reproduces locally, needs either coverage of that branch or a DECISIONS waiver 'floor-waiver:silenced-checker:runtime/scripts/verify.py', and tests (1)/(2)/(4) were still pending when I reported.
